text: Cycling is a fun and healthy way to get around. To ensure a smooth ride, you must use proper cycling equipment. Firstly, you need to have good brakes. Brakes are essential for slowing your bike down when you want to stop. If your brakes are not functioning properly, you may need to replace them. Secondly, make sure you have good tires. Tires provide your bike with support. If your tires are worn out or not inflated correctly, they can hinder your ability to ride. By using good brakes and tires, you can enjoy a safe and enjoyable cycling experience.
